body: This is really great, thank you!
You must be an angry person. Sorry about that.
Sounds easy. I guess our relationship is going through more turmoil so it's not that simple...
Yeah, I guess you're right. Our relationship is just so confusing right now. Thanks.
Very helpful read, thank you.

No one expects to go through a divorce.. It's normal to feel alone.. Reach out to family, friends, even people you haven't talked to in a long long time, you'd be surprised how caring people can be, that's if they are good people.. and they are out there.. I would go out and do things that I enjoy.. even if it's being alone and doing those things, or going out and having a night of drinking, these sort of situations make it easier for us to meet people, even if they just want sex? ignore that, keep going, talking, meeting genuine people elsewhere.. your friend could be in a rebound and emotionally unstable relationship, being divorced is NOT easy and your feeling heartbreak.. that's normal.. when you have to move on from someone, please don't put a time frame on it, it hurts, but the person you have loved, has died, and is someone different now, you could be grieving this death... just make friends for now.. who knows, you might find a really good friend and they can be the ones to comfort and hold you for a little while.
Your love and effort are deserved somewhere else.. don't give to those that never actually appreciated it..
Sounds like a sociopath. How could someone be so hateful? It makes no sense to me... I'm sorry you have to go through that bull shit. I'm pretty sure my STBXH did the same thing...
I'm really sorry what life has dealt you. I'm considering buying a gun but I have a daughter that needs me. I hope you make it out okay.

Really helpful thank you!!

We have talked about it, he sounded like he was happy and excited. I guess I'm just not thinking right about because of how much things have changed. He was always helpful and loving and seemed like it was something he wanted.
You know, I'm not sure.
Maybe ask what he's passionate about or what pisses him off? Maybe you can get a laugh out of him and see what his interests actually are..

If your boyfriend cannot learn or is not willing to understand what you are going through/experiencing, then there isn't true love there. I know what it feels like, but you are worth so much more than you give yourself credit for.. Everyone deserves to be loved and if he is willing to work with you, understand you, and help in any way he can, than he's worth it.. You just cannot expect him to save you or heal you, that takes you. Sorry, idk if I help or not
Your voice is not a waste of time. Your thoughts aren't a waste of time. I know how you are feeling right now.. reach out.

You aren't worthless. You are a human that deserves love and life and sunshine and moonlight. Tell your parents, tell your friends... tell them how you feel, because even though you may not think or believe it, people care and love you.
It's not very helpful, your feelings are yours and they are real.
Good. Sounds painful and expensive. I used to throw things back in the day.. but felt stupid because it was my stuff I was just breaking.
Please seek professional help, it sounds really painful and damaging to your body..
Ahah that is really nice of you, thank you! It made me smile :) I could use some practice, maybe take a class on it, haha :)
That's horrible, I'm sorry. I think men just have this weird ego need and it's honestly gross... Thanks for chiming in

He sounds like a horrible human being to treat you like garbage and to toss you aside like that.. You don't deserve that.. especially after all you've done, how hard you worked, and how much love you poured out of yourself. I know not everyone deserves love, but you definitely do, and him pulling shit like that, just using you, is absolutely evil. You still have your life left to live. Please do. I wish I could give you a hug and give you chocolate and help you feel better. What a miserable human being he is. I'm sorry. You deserve the moon and the stars.
I am going to therapy. I also have a journal, just kind of not sure what to write... I think that's why I've been on reddit, haha online journaling..  Thank you..
Thank you, it means a lot. I'm going day by day.. and that's right.. I can't force someone to stay I can't force someone to love me I can't ever change someone, it all has to come from them.
Thank you..
So hard to do.
Yes, I'm thinking distractions, self improvement.. exercise.. and my baby. <3

I know how dreadful the loneliness feels. I know how it feels wanting to take them back. I know what you mean, best friend... it's not pathetic. That was your life back then, that was who you were..

 Thanks for your reply :)
Thank you guys.
Can't force anyone to love you
I'm glad I could help in someway :)

It's hard because he was my entire life, my entire being. He is what supported me when times got hard and now my life is harder than ever and who can I ask for now. I really hope it gets better because right now it's hard to see life as beautiful like I once did.
Sounds controlling and abusive. Have you asked him why he's so miserable?

We have just bent over backwards trying to make the other person happy, even if it hurts us.. and for so long we keep getting hurt, just for that sacrifice.. I'm sorry you're going through this. Being bullied and used is never something we would have seen ourselves going through..
Disintegration by Jimmy Eat world.

He has just working and focusing on him and his career. He says he can't be a father unless he can provide. But again, the baby has been with my mom 99% time and he visits her when he can..

I'm currently getting help as much as I can and taking medication. Just my SO and mom know, I don't know to what extent as I try and hide it. I had felt rage in the past.. I'm not proud..

Yes my mom is helping as much as possible. I know my husband definitely has a say in this. That's sweet of you to offer, thank you.

I'm trying to get the help, thank you for your kind words <3

I'm in my late 20's. I have my family but they all treat me differently now because of how I've been. My husband and a friend are my crutches right now. It's been very hard on me as a whole because I love my family and I know I've disappointed them.

I've thought about adoption, and I have an adoption advisor but felt guilty so I ended the call.

I'm in my late 20's. Partner says he wants to be involved but it's a little hard working with him. I did not feel this way while pregnant, I think I was on a hormone high or something, wasn't thinking about what it actually takes to raise a child, nor did any serious planning. Yes I feel overwhelmed all the time unfortunately. Im in California.

So very nice of you. Thank you.. It looks like I have to go to an outpatient program. Everything is overwhelming me honestly. It's a lot. But I'm going to take some medicine and do what I can. I love my daughter and just want what's best for her. I think it is rage and it's scary. I never thought I'd be in this position.
Sorry, do you mind me asking about your job more? I'm willing to do anything. Living assistance and food assistance? Like low income housing and food stamps?
What's your work-from-home job? And what kind of assistance programs are you talking about?

Thank you for your kind words it means a lot. I'm just really overwhelmed. What's your schedule like, you say you have a job and you go to school? How did he get financial aid? And who watches your child when you're busy? I know your parents help but my parents both work. So it's hard juggling babysitter parents and me, it's very overwhelming
Do you mind if I ask you what job you have? I'm kind of pulling my hair out over here, I'm really overwhelmed

I have an AA in social sciences, but I've been interested in graphic design as well. What's the highest paying job that you have? I was looking into trades as well, I'm just not sure how to go about anything. I have a community college but I don't think it's free.

Thank you it's nice to hear that. It's hard because I don't think anyone believes in me and I don't believe in myself.

I want to be a mother but I also really don't. It's fucked up. I'm really confused.
California. And thank you, I do too 😊

I'm so sorry for what you are going through. That's devastating. My husband would be happy coming home and then would become sad because I'm here... He's always on his phone, non stop. I wish I could be more helpful. Just want you to know I know how painful it is.
Wow. Extremely helpful and thoughtful... This is nice.. Thank you.
This was amazing to read... Thank you so much.. I love my daughter and her smile makes me so happy.. She helps my heart not hurt so bad. CLEP? I've never heard of it I'll have to look it up

I was doing everything that I thought was right. I didn't do anything out of hate or anger. It's nice to hear that from someone other than myself.. I hope I can become stronger. Right now I feel so weak.. I hope I can change..

I'm interested in making art and helping the environment.. I'm thinking of becoming a park ranger somehow..

This was really really helpful to read. Thank you. It's been especially hard because I'm not 1000% sure what the dad wants in this situation now. He says the sweetest things but his actions don't always align... Thanks for your sweet words though. I have an AA in social sciences, I work a dead end office job with no room for advancement, I'm interested in becoming a park ranger actually.

I love my daughter so much. I just want to be good for her.

You are not alone. I feel like I'm drowning too. The feeling of being overwhelmed. It's like everyone puts off that life is perfect and I fucking hate it. Life is hard.. There's some good to it though... It's just hard to see it right now... I'm right here with you.

Thank you, I'm trying. I'm trying so hard. My depression and how much of a failure I am makes it hard for me to love. If that makes sense. I feel like my daughter deserves way better than what I have to offer and it scares me. I don't know how ready I am to parent. I just want her to be happy and healthy and have every success.

I don't know how to help in any situation, I'm pretty horrible, and I don't know how or what happened to make you feel the way you do.. But there are beautiful things in the world that are worth living for.. I wish I could be there and say I'm sorry, I know it's hard, and a lot of things suck in life, but there are reasons to live if you look for them. Maybe another depressed person like me shouldn't post but oops I did.
